Product Build

DoorDirect

Proptech · Consumer · 0→1 Build
Pre-launch

A broker-free rental app I built end-to-end — flats ranked by your real commute, not just the locality name.

Problem
Renting in Bangalore is broker-gated and low-trust: owners pay a month's rent in brokerage and field spam calls, while tenants chase stale, fake, or broker-posted listings that don't fit their real commute.
Build
Taken 0→1 solo: idea → competitive analysis → PRD & personas → UI/UX → a working React Native + Supabase app with phone-OTP auth, an owner listing flow, tenant discovery, and direct owner contact — prepped for Google Play closed testing.
Edge
Two things no incumbent does together: commute time to your own anchors (office, gym, home — not just a locality name), and Bangalore-specific signals like water security and monsoon flood risk. Positioned on trust and hyperlocal fit, not the commoditized "zero brokerage."
Solo — product, design & build · React Native · Expo · Supabase

Blinkit Teardown

Quick Commerce · Product Sense
Approach
Reverse-engineered Blinkit as one user in 5 modes (job × constraint), tracing every feeling to the design decision behind it.
Insight
The moat isn't speed — it's the first-open reflex, plus a zero-CAC share-cart loop that recruits new users for free.
Synthesis
Five moods = one person in five occasions; Blinkit wins each in turn until switching becomes unthinkable.

Product Project

Groww Gifting

Fintech · Consumer
Problem
A gap in corporate gifting (farewells, promotions, weddings) — colleagues awkwardly pool money via UPI chat groups with zero long-term value or emotional impact.
Idea
An investment gifting feature inside Groww — sender picks a recipient, amount, and occasion; funds land in the receiver's Groww Balance; receiver invests in Stocks/MF or withdraws.
Solution
A full 6-step gift flow (Create → Pay → Share → Redeem → Credit → Invest), occasion-tagged screens, and a sender dashboard with real-time tracking — edge cases handled, SEBI compliance preserved throughout.

03 · Product Concept

Groww Gifting

Fintech · Consumer
Problem
A gap in corporate gifting (farewells, promotions, weddings) — colleagues awkwardly pool money via UPI chat groups with zero long-term value or emotional impact.
Idea
An investment gifting feature inside Groww — sender picks a recipient, amount, and occasion; funds land in the receiver's Groww Balance; receiver invests in Stocks/MF or withdraws.
Solution
A full 6-step gift flow (Create → Pay → Share → Redeem → Credit → Invest), occasion-tagged screens, and a sender dashboard with real-time tracking. Handled edge cases — receiver declines (instant refund), no action in 60 days (sender reclaims), KYC pending, payment failure, wrong number — and preserved SEBI compliance throughout.
